name: vbrainstem-setup
title_zh: 一份随身携带的「我是谁」文件
tagline_zh: 受够了每次换工具都要重新调教 AI？把性格、偏好、手头项目写进一个文件，它跟你走。新 AI 打开即懂你。
tagline_en: Tired of retraining every new AI? Put who you are, how you like help, and what you're doing into one file that.
desc_en: Set up a person's own AI file, their vbrainstem: one file that makes any AI theirs, carrying who they are, how they like to be helped, what they are working on, and what they teach it over time. Use when someone says they want their AI to know them, wants to get started, wants their AI settings to follow them to another tool, or asks what a vbrainstem is.
why_zh: 它把「让 AI 懂你」从一次性聊天变成可积累的资产。你教它的每件事都沉淀进文件，越用越懂你。
why_en: It turns 'getting AI to know you' from a one-off chat into a growing asset. Every lesson persists in the file, so it knows you.
limit_zh: 只生成静态文件，不自动同步到任何 AI 平台。你需要手动把它粘贴到新工具的设置或系统提示词里。
limit_en: Creates a static file only—no auto-sync to AI platforms. You must paste it into each tool's settings or system prompt yourself; it won't manage.
title_en: A portable 'who you are' file that makes any AI help your.
